XY optimisation
Areas that are not optimally machined with the selected profile direction (X or Y axis) can be optionally
machined in a further operation in the opposite profile direction. The XY optimisation can either be carried
out without considering the surface steepness (option: S tandard) or dependent on the slope (option: S lope
mode).
